jobs.title: Compliance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Summary:

The India-based Compliance Operations Manager will support the management and execution of the Corporate Compliance Program, with responsibility for coordinating, overseeing, and driving key compliance operations activities across the Legal, Privacy and Compliance function. This role will provide operational support for compliance training, including tracking, follow-up, reporting, and related documentation as well as vendor oversight activities, including vendor compliance matters, site audit activities and follow-up monitoring. The role is intended to strengthen execution, documentation, and accountability across the broader Corporate Compliance program and its key operational activities.

Essential Functions:

 - Provide operational support for Corporate Compliance Program activities, including compliance training, vendor oversight, auditing and monitoring, policy governance, compliance documentation, and related activities

 - Support compliance management with training administration, including tracking completion status, preparing follow-up reports, monitoring delinquency trends, maintaining supporting documentation, and coordinating reminders or escalations as needed

 - Manage vendor oversight activities, including scheduling and documenting vendor tiering meetings, maintaining tiering trackers, coordinating site audit logistics, collecting audit evidence and tracking open follow-up items through closure

 - Coordinate client, vendor and third-party audit requests, including oversight of documentation and evidence collection, deadline management, and follow-up on outstanding requests and corrective action items

 - Manage compliance program tracking and reporting, including dashboards, status reports, meeting documentation, and other management tools that provide visibility into compliance activities, priorities, and progress

 - Coordinate with U.S. and India-based stakeholders to support timely information gathering, issue escalation, documentation review, and completion of assigned compliance operations activities

 - Assist with periodic reviews of compliance policies, procedures, and control documents by tracking review cycles, compiling feedback, and maintaining version control and approval documentation

 - Lead the initial preparation of Compliance Committee materials, including drafting meeting agendas, minutes, follow-up trackers, and coordinate review and finalization with Compliance leadership

 - Identify and assess operational gaps, overdue items, documentation deficiencies and process inefficiencies, and drive appropriate escalation, follow-up and resolution in coordination with Compliance leadership

 - Maintain subject matter awareness of applicable compliance processes and internal requirements to support consistent execution of compliance operations activities

 - Take on additional assignments and responsibilities as business needs dictate

Required (Must Have):

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (B.A./B.S.) or commensurate work experience

 - 7+ years of experience in compliance, risk management, legal operations, privacy, audit, or a related field.

 - Experience managing compliance programs, policies, and internal controls.

 - Strong project management and operational excellence skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.

 - Experience leading compliance investigations, risk assessments, audits, and remediation activities.

 - Ability to partner effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

 - Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred (Good to Have):

 - Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, privacy, or other regulated industries.

 - Knowledge of privacy and compliance frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, AI governance, and third-party risk management.

 - Experience supporting compliance operations in a global environment.

 - Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms such as OneTrust or similar tools.

 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Director - RWD Licensing
jobs.description:
Overview: 

Inovalon is seeking a strategic, results-oriented Senior Business Development Director - RWD Licensing to drive enterprise growth. This is a highly visible individual contributor role responsible for developing new business, expanding existing client relationships through cross-sell and upsell strategies, and serving as a trusted advisor to executive healthcare leaders.

As the owner of complex, enterprise sales opportunities, you will lead the full sales lifecycle: from opportunity identification and executive engagement through contract negotiation and successful transition to implementation. Working cross-functionally with Product, Clinical, Operations, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, you will help shape growth strategies while delivering measurable business outcomes for both clients and Inovalon.

Success in this role is measured by revenue growth, strategic account expansion, client satisfaction, and the ability to build lasting executive partnerships within some of the nation's leading health plans.

 

Duties and Responsibilities:

 - Develop and maintain expert-level knowledge of Inovalon's products, services, technology, operations, and market position to effectively articulate business value and differentiate our solutions.

 - Own the full enterprise business development lifecycle, including strategic prospecting, executive engagement, opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal creation, contract negotiation, and successful transition to implementation teams.

 - Drive revenue growth through new business development, strategic account expansion, and cross-sell and upsell opportunities across assigned accounts and target markets.

 - Build trusted relationships with Director, Vice President, C-suite, and other executive stakeholders within large healthcare organizations and serve as a strategic advisor throughout the customer journey.

 - Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account strategies designed to achieve and exceed revenue, market penetration, profitability, and client growth objectives.

 - Lead complex sales pursuits by influencing cross-functional teams across Product, Clinical, Implementation, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, and Executive Leadership to deliver exceptional client outcomes.

 - Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, CRM documentation, and opportunity reporting to ensure accurate business visibility and predictable revenue performance.

 - Provide market intelligence and customer insights to leadership, contributing to product strategy, solution enhancements, and long-term business planning.

 - Represent Inovalon at executive meetings, client presentations, and industry conferences to strengthen strategic partnerships and expand market presence.

 - Ensure compliance with all regulatory, contractual, quality, HIPAA, and company policy requirements.

 - Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support the continued growth and success of the organization.

 - Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;

 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position;

 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company;

 - Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function; and

 - We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such.

Job Requirements:

 - Proven success managing complex, consultative enterprise sales cycles, including lead generation, solution development, executive presentations, proposal management, and contract negotiation.

 - Demonstrated ability to develop trusted relationships with Director, Vice President, and C-suite executives within large healthcare organizations.

 - Experience leading highly strategic sales initiatives while influencing cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization without direct management responsibility.

 - Strong business acumen with a track record of developing territory strategies, navigating long enterprise sales cycles, and consistently exceeding revenue objectives.

 - Healthcare industry experience required, with health plan experience strongly preferred.

 - Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

 - Strong project management skills with exceptional attention to detail and disciplined documentation practices.

 - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

 - Management consulting and/or consultative enterprise sales experience preferred, with a demonstrated history of quota attainment, business growth, and career progression.

 - Willingness to travel nationally (potentially up to 25–30%) for executive client meetings, conferences, and industry events. 

Education:

 - BA/BS degree or equivalent experience required; and

 - MBA preferred.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

 - Sedentary work (i.e., sitting for long periods of time);

 - Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force;

 - Frequently or constantly to lift, carry push, pull or otherwise move objects and repetitive motions;

 - Subject to inside environmental conditions; and

 - Travel for this position will include less than 5% locally usually for training purposes.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

jobs.title: Director, Business Development
Senior Director, People Partnerships
Head of Partnerships
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Head of Partnerships is responsible for developing and executing Inovalon's enterprise partnership strategy to accelerate revenue growth, expand market reach, and strengthen the company's competitive position. This executive leader will identify, negotiate, and manage strategic alliances with technology companies, cloud providers, consulting firms, healthcare organizations, system integrators, channel partners, and emerging digital health innovators.

The successful candidate combines strategic thinking with commercial execution, building mutually beneficial relationships that create measurable business impact. This role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, Corporate Development, Legal, and Executive Leadership to develop scalable partnership programs that support Inovalon's long-term growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Partnership Strategy

 - Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise partnership strategy aligned with corporate growth priorities.

 - Identify new partnership opportunities across healthcare, technology, AI, analytics, cloud infrastructure, payer, provider, pharmacy, and life sciences markets.

 - Evaluate strategic alliances that enhance product offerings, expand distribution channels, or create new revenue streams.

 - Build a multi-year partnership roadmap supporting company objectives.

Business Development

 - Source, evaluate, negotiate, and execute strategic partnership agreements.

 - Lead executive-level negotiations involving commercial, technology, and go-to-market partnerships.

 - Develop business cases and financial models supporting investment decisions.

 - Identify opportunities for co-selling, co-marketing, product integration, and joint solution development.

Alliance Management

 - Establish executive relationships with key strategic partners.

 - Create governance frameworks, joint business plans, and success metrics.

 - Monitor partner performance against agreed objectives.

 - Resolve commercial or operational issues while strengthening long-term relationships.

 
 

Cross-Functional Leadership

 - Collaborate with Product Management to identify integration opportunities and customer needs.

 - Partner with Sales leadership to enable joint selling initiatives and pipeline development.

 - Work closely with Marketing on partner campaigns, events, thought leadership, and market positioning.

 - Coordinate with Legal and Compliance to structure partnership agreements within regulatory requirements.

 - Align with Finance on business performance, forecasting, and investment priorities.

Market Intelligence

 - Monitor healthcare technology trends, competitive partnerships, regulatory changes, and emerging ecosystem opportunities.

 - Identify new business models enabled by AI, interoperability, value-based care, and healthcare data exchange.

 - Represent Inovalon at industry conferences, executive forums, and customer events.

Performance Management

 - Define partnership KPIs and executive dashboards.

 - Measure partner-generated pipeline, revenue contribution, customer acquisition, solution adoption, and strategic impact.

 - Continuously optimize the partnership portfolio to maximize business value.

Qualifications

Required

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.

 - 12+ years of progressive experience in strategic partnerships, business development, alliances, or corporate strategy.

 - 5+ years leading high-performing partnership or alliance teams.

 - Experience within healthcare technology, health IT, healthcare analytics, SaaS, or enterprise software.

 - Demonstrated success negotiating complex, high-value strategic partnerships.

 - Strong executive presence with experience influencing C-suite stakeholders.

 - Excellent commercial, financial, negotiation, and communication skills.

Preferred

 - MBA or advanced business degree.

 - Experience working with health plans, provider organizations, pharmacy organizations, or life sciences companies.

 - Knowledge of value-based care, interoperability standards, healthcare data exchange, AI, and cloud technologies.

 - Experience managing relationships with major technology ecosystem partners and consulting organizations.

jobs.title: Senior Director, People Partnerships
Business Development Manager - Non Acute
jobs.description:
Overview: The Business Development Manager applies healthcare industry knowledge, advanced sales acumen, and disciplined territory management to drive growth within an assigned geographic region or book of business. This role independently manages the full sales lifecycle from prospecting through close while maintaining rigorous pipeline management and consistent use of sales operations processes. The Business Development Manager builds influence with both customer stakeholders and internal partners through exceptional communication, consultative selling, and data driven insights.


Duties and Responsibilities:
• Drive demand and increase awareness of Inovalon’s products by engaging prospects and nurturing existing relationships through effective communication across multiple channels, including in‐person meetings, virtual interactions, and phone outreach.
• Maintain disciplined and reliable execution of sales operations, including accurate CRM documentation (Salesforce), pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and follow‐up processes.
• Identify, qualify, and develop net new business opportunities while expanding and strengthening existing client relationships.
• Develop an understanding of Inovalon’s enterprise solutions and the ONE Inovalon mission, identifying and connecting opportunities across business units and collaborating with colleagues to ensure customers receive the full value of Inovalon’s offerings—even beyond the assigned territory or BU.
• Work closely with assigned Sales team and other team members in your territory to qualify prospect accounts, ensure web demonstrations are completed in a timely and thorough manner, and all sales opportunities are properly gathered with Marketing, Sales, and Business Development departments.
• Partner with Marketing to communicate customer insights, competitive trends, and emerging needs that influence product and go to market strategy.
• Lead or support product presentations, solution positioning, and demonstration processes in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Business Development teams.
• Develop a deep understanding of the territory’s market dynamics, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform strategic sales planning.
• Conduct effective discovery, needs assessments, and consultative conversations that influence customer decision makers.
• Collaborate with assigned Sales Representatives, Marketing, and Business Development leaders to synergize sales efforts, follow up activities and support each other with identified new business opportunities and clients;
• Travel to meet with prospective and existing clients to drive sales outcomes and strengthen relationships.
• Serve as an informal mentor or coach to new hires by modeling best practices in sales process discipline, communication, and customer engagement.
• Contribute to a positive team culture that emphasizes accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
• Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
• Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.


Job Requirements:
• 3-5 years of progressive sales or business development experience, preferably within the healthcare, health technology, or payer/provider space.
• Demonstrated success managing a territory or book of business with measurable revenue outcomes.
• Proven track record of consultative, solution‐based selling, including running discovery, developing value propositions, and influencing cross‐functional decision‐makers.
• Experience maintaining accurate pipeline management, forecasting discipline, and CRM hygiene (Salesforce strongly preferred) with limited supervision.
• Advanced communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical or clinical concepts into compelling business value.
• Ability to independently drive the full sales lifecycle—prospecting, qualifying, presenting, negotiating, and closing.
• Strong territory planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance new business generation and account expansion.
• Proven ability to conduct strategic, value‐based discussions with C‐suite leaders to advance complex sales opportunities.
• Leadership or supervisory experience preferred.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; strong command of PowerPoint and Excel for sales presentations and territory planning.


Education:
• BA or BS degree in technical or business discipline and or related field, or equivalent work experience;

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

jobs.title: Principal Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.

Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

Who You Are

As a Principal Sales Engineer, you lead pre-sales technical efforts that help clients understand how Inovalon solutions fit their business needs and support revenue growth and retention. You partner closely with Business Solutions and Sales teams to develop technical strategies, strengthen client relationships, and deliver value across products and quality measures such as Risk Score Accuracy, Quality Measurement & Improvement, EHR, Pharma, Provider Score, and HEDIS. You are a subject matter expert who brings technical depth, strong judgment, and client-facing credibility to complex sales opportunities.

What You'll Do

 - Lead technical pre-sales activities within an assigned territory or region, helping drive opportunities and supporting sales strategies that retain and grow client revenue.

 - Develop and deliver complex technical proposals, presentations, and product demonstrations tailored to client business needs and technical environments.

 - Partner with Business Solutions and Sales teams to shape sales approaches, support attainment of sales quotas, and provide technical responses for RFIs and RFPs.

 - Analyze client needs and design solution approaches that align Inovalon products with client goals, including custom technical designs for complex opportunities.

 - Advise clients and internal partners on product functionality, integration, usage, features, availability, and strategic fit within client environments.

 - Build technical relationships across all levels of client management and communicate proactively to support successful technical sales campaigns.

 - Serve as a regional resource for technical expertise and best practices, sharing knowledge and providing first-level escalation support, direction, and mentoring to colleagues.

 - Advocate for clients during pre-sales activities and support limited post-sales needs when necessary to help ensure continuity and satisfaction.

 - Collaborate with internal partners to strengthen technical capabilities and competencies that contribute to successful revenue generation.

 - Maintain current knowledge of complex product and industry topics through participation in industry organizations, forums, and client-facing presentations delivered virtually or onsite.

What You'll Need

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in sales engineering, healthcare products, and/or Risk Adjustment, Quality Measures, EHR, Pharma, Provider, ScriptMed, or related areas, preferably in a public company.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Healthcare, Technical, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead successful technical sales campaigns and contribute best practices across a region or team.

 - Strong business solution selling skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly with clients and internal stakeholders.

 - Experience preparing technical proposals, presentations, and responses to product and industry questions.

 - Knowledge of product functionality, integration, and usage, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into client value.

 - Ability to learn new products, market needs, and client environments quickly, and apply that learning to improve performance as business needs evolve.

 - Ability to influence, collaborate with, and mentor cross-functional partners, while building trusted relationships and handling differing viewpoints constructively.

 - Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, client requirements, and opportunity strategies while staying focused on business outcomes.

 - Ability to generate practical, client-focused solutions and identify creative ways to position products within complex client environments.

 - Strong analytical skills to assess client business needs, evaluate strategic fit, and develop sound technical approaches based on available information.

Nice to have: 

 - Experience with Client Solutions Development.

Our Shared Commitments

 - Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;

 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and

 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

Work Environment

 - This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Acute
jobs.description:
Overview: The Business Development Manager applies healthcare industry knowledge, advanced sales acumen, and disciplined territory management to drive growth within an assigned geographic region or book of business. This role independently manages the full sales lifecycle from prospecting through close while maintaining rigorous pipeline management and consistent use of sales operations processes. The Business Development Manager builds influence with both customer stakeholders and internal partners through exceptional communication, consultative selling, and data driven insights.


Duties and Responsibilities:
• Drive demand and increase awareness of Inovalon’s products by engaging prospects and nurturing existing relationships through effective communication across multiple channels, including in‐person meetings, virtual interactions, and phone outreach.
• Maintain disciplined and reliable execution of sales operations, including accurate CRM documentation (Salesforce), pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and follow‐up processes.
• Identify, qualify, and develop net new business opportunities while expanding and strengthening existing client relationships.
• Develop an understanding of Inovalon’s enterprise solutions and the ONE Inovalon mission, identifying and connecting opportunities across business units and collaborating with colleagues to ensure customers receive the full value of Inovalon’s offerings—even beyond the assigned territory or BU.
• Work closely with assigned Sales team and other team members in your territory to qualify prospect accounts, ensure web demonstrations are completed in a timely and thorough manner, and all sales opportunities are properly gathered with Marketing, Sales, and Business Development departments.
• Partner with Marketing to communicate customer insights, competitive trends, and emerging needs that influence product and go to market strategy.
• Lead or support product presentations, solution positioning, and demonstration processes in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Business Development teams.
• Develop a deep understanding of the territory’s market dynamics, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform strategic sales planning.
• Conduct effective discovery, needs assessments, and consultative conversations that influence customer decision makers.
• Collaborate with assigned Sales Representatives, Marketing, and Business Development leaders to synergize sales efforts, follow up activities and support each other with identified new business opportunities and clients;
• Travel to meet with prospective and existing clients to drive sales outcomes and strengthen relationships.
• Serve as an informal mentor or coach to new hires by modeling best practices in sales process discipline, communication, and customer engagement.
• Contribute to a positive team culture that emphasizes accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
• Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
• Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company.


Job Requirements:
• 3-5 years of progressive sales or business development experience, preferably within the healthcare, health technology, or payer/provider space.
• Demonstrated success managing a territory or book of business with measurable revenue outcomes.
• Proven track record of consultative, solution‐based selling, including running discovery, developing value propositions, and influencing cross‐functional decision‐makers.
• Experience maintaining accurate pipeline management, forecasting discipline, and CRM hygiene (Salesforce strongly preferred) with limited supervision.
• Advanced communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical or clinical concepts into compelling business value.
• Ability to independently drive the full sales lifecycle—prospecting, qualifying, presenting, negotiating, and closing.
• Strong territory planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance new business generation and account expansion.
• Proven ability to conduct strategic, value‐based discussions with C‐suite leaders to advance complex sales opportunities.
• Leadership or supervisory experience preferred.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; strong command of PowerPoint and Excel for sales presentations and territory planning.


Education:
• BA or BS degree in technical or business discipline and or related field, or equivalent work experience;

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.

To review the legal requirements, including all labor law posters, please visit this link https://postings.govdocs.com/#/8sZXnFNWk3KYs3F

To review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this link https://www.inovalon.com/privacy-policy/

Work Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).
